query: WITH f AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693), n AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693), m AS (SELECT id FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693) SELECT 'source_pages' AS metric,count(*)::text AS value FROM public.source_pages WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 UNION ALL SELECT 'facts',count(*)::text FROM f UNION ALL SELECT 'notes',count(*)::text FROM n UNION ALL SELECT 'mcqs',count(*)::text FROM m UNION ALL SELECT 'mcq_options',count(*)::text FROM public.gk_mcq_options WHERE mcq_id IN (SELECT id FROM m) UNION ALL SELECT 'flashcards',count(*)::text FROM public.flashcards WHERE source_key LIKE 'batch0689-0693:%' UNION ALL SELECT 'search_documents',count(*)::text FROM public.search_documents WHERE (entity_type='fact' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM f)) OR (entity_type='note' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM n)) OR (entity_type='mcq' AND entity_id IN (SELECT id FROM m)) UNION ALL SELECT 'verifications',count(*)::text FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_verification_statuses',count(*)::text FROM public.fact_verifications WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 AND verification_status::text NOT IN ('verified','source_attributed','conflicting','unverified','rejected') UNION ALL SELECT 'invalid_tag_categories',count(*)::text FROM public.content_tag_assignments a JOIN public.content_tags t ON t.id=a.tag_id WHERE a.source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 AND t.category::text NOT IN ('domain','content_type','theme','exam_source','quality') UNION ALL SELECT 'malformed_facts',count(*)::text FROM public.gk_facts WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 AND (title='' OR fact_text='' OR canonical_hash IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'malformed_notes',count(*)::text FROM public.gk_notes WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 AND (title='' OR content='' OR canonical_hash IS NULL) UNION ALL SELECT 'malformed_mcqs',count(*)::text FROM public.gk_mcqs WHERE source_page BETWEEN 689 AND 693 AND (question='' OR correct_option IS NULL OR canonical_hash IS NULL) LIMIT 20;
